name: Law on Artificial Intelligence (Luật Trí tuệ nhân tạo — Law No. 134/2025/QH15, enacted Dec 10, 2025, effective March 1, 2026; supersedes Chapter IV of Law No. 71/2025/QH15)
description: Law on Artificial Intelligence (Luật Trí tuệ nhân tạo — Law No. 134/2025/QH15, enacted Dec 10, 2025, effective March 1, 2026; supersedes Chapter IV of Law No. 71/2025/QH15)
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Government of Vietnam (chinhphu.vn) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
